<h1 id="1-前言">1 前言</h1>
<p>​    本文基于 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-android/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-android</a> 10.1.0 进行源码分析，主要介绍 Rive 的渲染类型、RendererType 透传流程、Surface 透传流程、渲染流程、启动渲染流程、暂停渲染流程等内容。</p>
<p>​    rive-android 类图框架如下。图中，蓝色的类表示 rive-android 中 Kotlin 代码，绿色的类表示 rive-android 中 C++ 代码，橙色的类表示 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-runtime</a> 中代码（下同）。本文只解读 rive-android 的源码，不解读 rive-runtime 的源码。</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3135663/202510/3135663-20251002122604930-836101365.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<h1 id="2-渲染类型">2 渲染类型</h1>
<p>​    rive-android 10.0.0 之前的版本，有三种渲染类型，分别是：Skia、Rive、Canvas，默认是 Skia 类型。10.0.0 版本开始舍弃了 Skia 渲染类型，默认是 Rive 类型。Skia 和 Rive 渲染类型底层都是基于 EGL 环境进行离屏渲染。</p>
<p>​    RenderType 类源码如下。</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.core.RendererType.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">enum class RendererType(val value: Int) {
    Rive(0),
    Canvas(1);

    companion object {
        fun fromIndex(index: Int): RendererType {
            val maxIndex = entries.size
            ...
            return entries[index]
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="3-renderertype-透传流程">3 RendererType 透传流程</h1>
<p>​    本节将介绍 RendererType 如何一步一步透传下去，直到最终创建 DrawableThreadState 对象。本节中，读者需要重点关注 RendererType 是如何在各个类之间传递的。RendererType 透传流程图如下。</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3135663/202510/3135663-20251002122604905-409702208.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="31-设置-renderertype-的源头">3.1 设置 RendererType 的源头</h2>
<p>​    用户在初始化 Rive 环境时，可以指定 RenderType，如下。</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">Rive.init(applicationContext, defaultRenderer = RendererType.Rive)
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="点击并拖拽以移动" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3135663/202510/3135663-20251002122604837-582820591.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>​    也可以在布局文件中指定 RenderType（如果想使用 Winscope 或 Perfetto 查看 Trace，可以配置 <strong>riveTraceAnimations</strong> 参数），如下。</p>
<pre><code class="language-XML">&lt;app.rive.runtime.kotlin.RiveAnimationView
  app:riveRenderer="Rive"
  app:riveTraceAnimations="true"
  … /&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>​    无论是哪种方式，在 RiveAnimationView 对象被创建时，渲染类型会保存在 rendererAttributes 对象的 rendererType 属性中（rendererAttributes 是 RendererAttributes 类型）。</p>
<h2 id="32-创建-riveartboardrenderer">3.2 创建 RiveArtboardRenderer</h2>
<p>​    RiveAnimationView 继承了 RiveTextureView，RiveTextureView 继承了 TextureView，并重写了其 onAttachedToWindow 函数，如下。</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.RiveTextureView.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">@CallSuper
override fun onAttachedToWindow() {
	super.onAttachedToWindow()
	surfaceTextureListener = this
	isOpaque = false
	renderer = createRenderer().apply { make() }
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    在 RiveAnimationView 中重写了 createRenderer 函数，如下。</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.RiveAnimationView.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">override fun createRenderer(): Renderer {
	return RiveArtboardRenderer(
		trace = rendererAttributes.riveTraceAnimations,
		controller = controller,
		rendererType = rendererAttributes.rendererType,
	)
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    RiveArtboardRenderer 只有主构造函数，没有次要构造函数，如下。关于主构造函数和次要构造函数的介绍详见 → <a href="https://zhyan8.blog.csdn.net/article/details/136441371" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">类和对象</a>。</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.renderers.RiveArtboardRenderer.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">open class RiveArtboardRenderer(
    trace: Boolean = false,
    rendererType: RendererType = Rive.defaultRendererType,
    private var controller: RiveFileController,
) : Renderer(rendererType, trace)
</code></pre>
<p>​    Renderer 的也只有主构造函数，没有次要构造函数，如下。</p>
<p>​     app.rive.runtime.kotlin.renderers.Renderer.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">abstract class Renderer(
    @get:VisibleForTesting(otherwise = VisibleForTesting.PRIVATE)
    var type: RendererType = Rive.defaultRendererType,
    val trace: Boolean = false
) : NativeObject(NULL_POINTER), Choreographer.FrameCallback
</code></pre>
<h2 id="33-创建-jnirenderer">3.3 创建 JNIRenderer</h2>
<p>​    我们再回到 RiveTextureView 的 onAttachedToWindow 函数中，在 createRenderer 之后，调用了 Renderer 的 make 函数。make 函数的源码如下。cppPointer 是在 NativeObject 中定义的 Long 类型变量，对应 C++ 中的指针变量，指向的是 JNI 中 JNIRenderer 对象。在 make 函数中又调用了 constructor 函数，它在 JNI 中有实现。（注意：这里的 constructor 不是 Renderer 的构造函数，因为其前面加了 fun，构造函数前面不能加 fun）</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.renderers.Renderer.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">@CallSuper
open fun make() {
	if (!hasCppObject) {
		cppPointer = constructor(trace, type.value)
		refs.incrementAndGet()
	}
}

/** Instantiates JNIRenderer in C++ */
private external fun constructor(trace: Boolean, type: Int): Long
</code></pre>
<p>​    全局搜索 "Renderer_constructor"，找到 JNI 中的 constructor 函数的实现如下。</p>
<p>​    bindings/bindings_renderer.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">JNIEXPORT jlong JNICALL
Java_app_rive_runtime_kotlin_renderers_Renderer_constructor(JNIEnv* env, jobject ktRenderer,
	jboolean trace, jint type)
{
	RendererType rendererType = static_cast&lt;RendererType&gt;(type);
	JNIRenderer* renderer = new JNIRenderer(ktRenderer, trace, rendererType);
	...
	return (jlong)renderer;
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    JNIRenderer 的构造函数如下，这里会创建 RefWorker 对象保存在 m_worker 中，创建 ITracer 对象保存在 m_tracer 中。如果 trace 为 false，将创建 NoopTracer 对象，其 beginSection、endSection 函数都是空实现；如果 trace 为 true，将创建 Tracer 对象，其 beginSection 函数将调用 ATrace_beginSection，endSection 函数将调用 ATrace_endSection（详见 aosp 中的 frameworks/base/native/android/trace.cpp），这时用户就可以使用 Winscope 或 Perfetto 查看 Trace 了。</p>
<p>​    models/jni_renderer.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">JNIRenderer::JNIRenderer(jobject ktRenderer, bool trace, const RendererType rendererType) :
    m_worker(RefWorker::CurrentOrFallback(rendererType)),
    m_ktRenderer(GetJNIEnv()-&gt;NewGlobalRef(ktRenderer)),
    m_tracer(getTracer(trace))
{}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="34-创建-refworker">3.4 创建 RefWorker</h2>
<p>​    RefWorker::CurrentOrFallback 的源码如下。</p>
<p>​    helpers/work_ref.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">rcp&lt;RefWorker&gt; RefWorker::CurrentOrFallback(RendererType rendererType)
{
    rcp&lt;RefWorker&gt; currentOrFallback;
    switch (rendererType)
    {
        case RendererType::None:
            assert(false);
            break;
        case RendererType::Rive:
            currentOrFallback = RiveWorker();
            break;
        case RendererType::Canvas:
            currentOrFallback = CanvasWorker();
            break;
    }
    if (currentOrFallback == nullptr)
    {
        currentOrFallback = CanvasWorker();
    }
    return currentOrFallback;
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    RiveWorker 和 CanvasWorker 函数实现如下。</p>
<p>​    helpers/work_ref.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">rcp&lt;RefWorker&gt; RefWorker::RiveWorker()
{
    static enum class RiveRendererSupport { unknown, no, yes } s_isSupported;
    static std::unique_ptr&lt;RefWorker&gt; s_riveWorker;
    ...
    if (s_isSupported == RiveRendererSupport::unknown)
    {
        std::unique_ptr&lt;RefWorker&gt; candidateWorker(new RefWorker(RendererType::Rive));
        candidateWorker-&gt;runAndWait(
            [](rive_android::DrawableThreadState* threadState) {
                PLSThreadState* plsThreadState = static_cast&lt;PLSThreadState*&gt;(threadState);
                s_isSupported = plsThreadState-&gt;renderContext() != nullptr ? RiveRendererSupport::yes : RiveRendererSupport::no;
            });
        if (s_isSupported == RiveRendererSupport::yes)
        {
            s_riveWorker = std::move(candidateWorker);
        }
        ...
    }
    if (s_riveWorker != nullptr)
    {
        ++s_riveWorker-&gt;m_externalRefCount;
    }
    return rcp(s_riveWorker.get());
}

rcp&lt;RefWorker&gt; RefWorker::CanvasWorker()
{
    if (s_canvasWorker == nullptr)
    {
        s_canvasWorker = std::unique_ptr&lt;RefWorker&gt;(new RefWorker(RendererType::Canvas));
    }
    ++s_canvasWorker-&gt;m_externalRefCount;
    return rcp(s_canvasWorker.get());
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    RefWorker 继承 WorkerThread，如下。</p>
<p>​    helpers/work_ref.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">explicit RefWorker(const RendererType rendererType) :
	WorkerThread(RendererName(rendererType), Affinity::None, rendererType)
{}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="35-创建-workthread">3.5 创建 WorkThread</h2>
<p>​    WorkThread 的构造函数如下，可以看到这里创建了一个线程，用于处理渲染任务。</p>
<p>​    helpers/worker_thread.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">WorkerThread(const char* name, Affinity affinity, const RendererType rendererType) :
	m_RendererType(rendererType),
	mName(name),
	mAffinity(affinity),
	mWorkMutex{}
{
	mThread = std::thread([this]() { threadMain(); });
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    threadMain 函数的实现如下。首先通过 MakeThreadState 函数创建 DrawableThreadState 对象；接着进入 for 无限循环体中，如果 mWorkQueue 为空（mWorkQueue 中的元素是 function&lt;void(DrawableThreadState*) 类型的函数指针），线程将处于 wait 状态，否则从工作队列中取出函数指针元素，并执行函数；如果从工作队列中取出的函数指针为空，将结束线程。</p>
<p>​    helpers/worker_thread.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void threadMain()
{
	setAffinity(mAffinity);
	...
	m_threadState = MakeThreadState(m_RendererType);
	std::unique_lock lock(mWorkMutex);
	for (;;)
	{
		while (mWorkQueue.empty())
		{
			m_workPushedCondition.wait(mWorkMutex);
		}
		Work work = mWorkQueue.front();
		mWorkQueue.pop();

		if (!work)
		{
			// A null function is a special token that tells the thread to terminate.
			break;
		}

		lock.unlock();
		work(m_threadState.get());
		lock.lock();

		++m_lastCompletedWorkID;
		m_workedCompletedCondition.notify_all();
	}
	m_threadState.reset();
	DetachThread();
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="36-创建-drawablethreadstate">3.6 创建 DrawableThreadState</h2>
<p>​    MakeThreadState 函数的实现如下。</p>
<p>​    helpers/worker_thread.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">std::unique_ptr&lt;DrawableThreadState&gt; WorkerThread::MakeThreadState(const RendererType type)
{
    switch (type)
    {
        case RendererType::Canvas:
            return std::make_unique&lt;CanvasThreadState&gt;();
        default:
        case RendererType::Rive:
            return std::make_unique&lt;PLSThreadState&gt;();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    CanvasThreadState 继承 DrawableThreadState，PLSThreadState 继承 EGLThreadState，EGLThreadState 继承 DrawableThreadState（在 rive-android 10.0.0 之前的版本，还有 SkiaThreadState 也继承 EGLThreadState，它对应的 RenderType 是 Skia）。</p>
<h3 id="361-drawablethreadstateeglthreadstatecanvasthreadstate-接口定义">3.6.1 DrawableThreadState、EGLThreadState、CanvasThreadState 接口定义</h3>
<p>​    DrawableThreadState、EGLThreadState、CanvasThreadState 的接口定义如下。</p>
<p>​    helpers/thread_state_egl.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">class DrawableThreadState
{
public:
    virtual ~DrawableThreadState(){};
    virtual void swapBuffers() = 0;
};

class EGLThreadState : public DrawableThreadState
{
public:
    EGLThreadState();

    virtual ~EGLThreadState() = 0;

    EGLSurface createEGLSurface(ANativeWindow*);

    virtual void destroySurface(EGLSurface) = 0;

    virtual void makeCurrent(EGLSurface) = 0;

    void swapBuffers() override;

protected:
    EGLSurface m_currentSurface = EGL_NO_SURFACE;
    EGLDisplay m_display = EGL_NO_DISPLAY;
    EGLContext m_context = EGL_NO_CONTEXT;
    EGLConfig m_config = static_cast&lt;EGLConfig&gt;(0);
};

class CanvasThreadState : public DrawableThreadState
{
public:
    void swapBuffers() override {}
};
</code></pre>
<h3 id="362-创建-eglthreadstate">3.6.2 创建 EGLThreadState</h3>
<p>​    EGLThreadState 的构造函数源码如下，它实现了 EGL 环境创建 5 步中的前 3步，剩下 2 步在 PLSThreadState 的构造函数中实现。EGL 环境创建详见 → <a href="https://zhyan8.blog.csdn.net/article/details/123887797" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">EGL+FBO离屏渲染</a>。</p>
<p>​    helpers/thread_state_egl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">EGLThreadState::EGLThreadState()
{
    // 创建 EGLDisplay
    m_display = eglGetDisplay(EGL_DEFAULT_DISPLAY);
    ...
    if (!eglInitialize(m_display, 0, 0))
    {
        ...
        return;
    }

    // 创建 EGLConfig
    const EGLint configAttributes[] = {...};
    ...
    eglChooseConfig(m_display, configAttributes, supportedConfigs.data(), num_configs, &amp;num_configs);
    ...

	// 创建 EGLContext
    m_context = eglCreateContext(m_display, m_config, nullptr, contextAttributes);
    ...
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="363-创建-plsthreadstate">3.6.3 创建 PLSThreadState</h3>
<p>​    PLSThreadState 的构造函数源码如下，它实现了 EGL 环境创建 5 步中的后 2步。eglCreatePbufferSurface 用于创建一个离屏渲染的 EGL 表面，Pbuffer 表面是一个虚拟的离屏缓冲区，可以在其中进行渲染操作，而不直接与屏幕交互。rive::gpu::RenderContextGLImpl::MakeContext 的源码不在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-android" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-android</a> 代码库中，在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-runtime</a> 代码库中，详见 → <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/blob/main/renderer/src/gl/render_context_gl_impl.cpp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">render_context_gl_impl.cpp</a>。</p>
<p>​    helpers/thread_state_psl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">PLSThreadState::PLSThreadState()
{
    // 创建 EGLSurface
    const EGLint PbufferAttrs[] = {...};
    m_backgroundSurface = eglCreatePbufferSurface(m_display, m_config, PbufferAttrs);
    ...

    // 绑定 EGLSurface 和 EGLContext 到显示设备 (EGLDisplay)
    eglMakeCurrent(m_display, m_backgroundSurface, m_backgroundSurface, m_context);
    m_currentSurface = m_backgroundSurface;

    m_renderContext = rive::gpu::RenderContextGLImpl::MakeContext();
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="4-surface-透传流程">4 Surface 透传流程</h1>
<p>​    本节将介绍 Surface 如何一步一步透传下去，直到最终创建 rive::RiveRenderer 对象或 CanvasRenderer 对象。本节中，读者需要重点关注 Surface 是如何在各个类之间传递的。Surface 透传流程图如下。</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3135663/202510/3135663-20251002122604892-863136281.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="41-surface-创建的源头">4.1 Surface 创建的源头</h2>
<p>​    在 RiveTextureView 的 onSurfaceTextureAvailable 方法中，创建了 Surface 如下。</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.RiveTextureView.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">@CallSuper
override fun onSurfaceTextureAvailable(
	surfaceTexture: SurfaceTexture, width: Int, height: Int) {
	if (this::viewSurface.isInitialized) {
		viewSurface.release()
	}
	viewSurface = Surface(surfaceTexture)
	renderer?.apply {
		stop()
		setSurface(viewSurface)
	}
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="42-renderersetsurface">4.2 Renderer.setSurface</h2>
<p>​    Renderer 的 setSurface 函数源码如下。cppPointer 是在 NativeObject 中定义的 Long 类型变量，对应 C++ 中的指针变量，指向的是 JNI 中 JNIRenderer 对象。</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.renderers.Renderer.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">fun setSurface(surface: Surface) {
	cppSetSurface(surface, cppPointer)
	isAttached = true
	start()
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="43-jni-cppsetsurface">4.3 JNI cppSetSurface</h2>
<p>​    全局搜索 Renderer_cppSetSurface，找到 JNI 层 cppSetSurface 函数的实现如下。对于 Rive 渲染类型，将创建一个 ANativeWindow 指针（ANativeWindow_fromSurface 函数详见 aosp 中的 frameworks/base/native/android/native_window_jni.cpp），并将 ANativeWindow 指针传递到 JNIRenderer 中；对于 Canvas 渲染类型，直接将 Surface 传递到 JNIRenderer 中。</p>
<p>​    bindings/bindings_renderer.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
Java_app_rive_runtime_kotlin_renderers_Renderer_cppSetSurface(JNIEnv* env, jobject,
	jobject surface, jlong rendererRef)
{
	JNIRenderer* renderer = reinterpret_cast&lt;JNIRenderer*&gt;(rendererRef);
	if (renderer-&gt;rendererType() != RendererType::Canvas)
	{
		ANativeWindow* surfaceWindow = ANativeWindow_fromSurface(env, surface);
		reinterpret_cast&lt;JNIRenderer*&gt;(rendererRef) -&gt;setSurface(surfaceWindow);
		if (surfaceWindow)
		{
			ANativeWindow_release(surfaceWindow);
		}
	}
	else
	{
		renderer-&gt;setSurface(surface);
	}
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="44-jnirenderersetsurface">4.4 JNIRenderer::setSurface</h2>
<p>​    JNIRenderer::setSurface 的源码如下。m_worker 是 RefWorker 类的实例，RefWorker 继承 WorkThread，WorkThread 中创建了工作线程（见 3.5 节)，并且有个 run 函数，m_worker-&gt;run 表示把任务提交到 WorkThread 中的工作线程中执行。</p>
<p>​    models/jni_renderer.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void JNIRenderer::setSurface(SurfaceVariant surface)
{
    SurfaceVariant oldSurface = m_surface;
    acquireSurface(surface);
    m_worker-&gt;run([this, oldSurface](DrawableThreadState* threadState) mutable {
        m_workerThreadID = std::this_thread::get_id();
        ...
        if (m_surface.index() &gt; 0)
        {
            m_workerImpl = WorkerImpl::Make(m_surface, threadState, m_worker-&gt;rendererType());
        }
    });
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="45-workerimplmake">4.5 WorkerImpl::Make</h2>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">std::unique_ptr&lt;WorkerImpl&gt; WorkerImpl::Make(SurfaceVariant surface,
    DrawableThreadState* threadState, const RendererType type)
{
    ...
    bool success = false;
    std::unique_ptr&lt;WorkerImpl&gt; impl;
    switch (type)
    {
        case RendererType::Rive:
        {
            ANativeWindow* window = std::get&lt;ANativeWindow*&gt;(surface);
            impl = std::make_unique&lt;PLSWorkerImpl&gt;(window, threadState, &amp;success);
            break;
        }
        case RendererType::Canvas:
        {
            jobject ktSurface = std::get&lt;jobject&gt;(surface);
            impl = std::make_unique&lt;CanvasWorkerImpl&gt;(ktSurface, &amp;success);
        }
        default:
            break;
    }
    ...
    return impl;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="46-创建-workerimpl">4.6 创建 WorkerImpl</h2>
<p>​    PLSWorkerImpl 继承 EGLWorkerImpl，EGLWorkerImpl 和 CanvasWorkerImpl 继承 WorkerImpl。</p>
<h3 id="461-workerimpl-接口定义">4.6.1 WorkerImpl 接口定义</h3>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">class WorkerImpl
{
public:
    static std::unique_ptr&lt;WorkerImpl&gt; Make(SurfaceVariant, DrawableThreadState*, const RendererType);

    void start(jobject ktRenderer, std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::time_point);

    void stop();

    void doFrame(ITracer*, DrawableThreadState*, jobject ktRenderer, std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::time_point);

    virtual void prepareForDraw(DrawableThreadState*) const = 0;

    virtual void destroy(DrawableThreadState*) = 0;

    virtual void flush(DrawableThreadState*) const = 0;

    virtual rive::Renderer* renderer() const = 0;

protected:
    jclass m_ktRendererClass = nullptr;
    jmethodID m_ktDrawCallback = nullptr;
    jmethodID m_ktAdvanceCallback = nullptr;
    std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::time_point m_lastFrameTime;
    bool m_isStarted = false;
};
</code></pre>
<h3 id="462-创建-eglworkerimpl">4.6.2 创建 EGLWorkerImpl</h3>
<p>​    EGLWorkerImpl 的构造函数如下。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">class EGLWorkerImpl : public WorkerImpl
{
...
protected:
    EGLWorkerImpl(struct ANativeWindow* window, DrawableThreadState* threadState, bool* success)
    {
        *success = false;
        auto eglThreadState = static_cast&lt;EGLThreadState*&gt;(threadState);
        m_eglSurface = eglThreadState-&gt;createEGLSurface(window);
        if (m_eglSurface == EGL_NO_SURFACE)
            return;
        *success = true;
    }
...
};
</code></pre>
<p>​    EGLThreadState::createEGLSurface 函数源码如下。eglCreateWindowSurface 用于创建一个与屏幕窗口相关的 EGL 表面，这个表面通常与设备的窗口系统交互，使得 OpenGL ES 渲染的内容能够显示在屏幕上（补充：eglCreatePbufferSurface 用于创建一个离屏渲染的 EGL 表面）。</p>
<p>​    helpers/thread_state_egl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">EGLSurface EGLThreadState::createEGLSurface(ANativeWindow* window)
{
    if (!window)
    {
        return EGL_NO_SURFACE;
    }
    ...
    // 创建一个与屏幕窗口相关的 EGL 表面, 这个表面通常与设备的窗口系统交, 使得 OpenGL ES 渲染的内容能够显示在屏幕上
    auto res = eglCreateWindowSurface(m_display, m_config, window, nullptr);
    ...
    return res;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="463-创建-plsworkerimpl">4.6.3 创建 PLSWorkerImpl</h3>
<p>​    PLSWorkerImpl 的构造函数如下，最终创建了 rive::RiveRenderer 对象，其源码不在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-android" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-android</a> 代码库中，在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-runtime</a> 代码库中，详见 → <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/blob/main/renderer/src/rive_renderer.cpp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive_renderer.cpp</a>。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">PLSWorkerImpl::PLSWorkerImpl(struct ANativeWindow* window, DrawableThreadState* threadState, bool* success) :
    EGLWorkerImpl(window, threadState, success)
{
    if (!success)
    {
        return;
    }

    auto eglThreadState = static_cast&lt;EGLThreadState*&gt;(threadState);

    eglThreadState-&gt;makeCurrent(m_eglSurface);
    rive::gpu::RenderContext* renderContext = PLSWorkerImpl::PlsThreadState(eglThreadState)-&gt;renderContext();
    if (renderContext == nullptr)
    {
        return; // PLS was not supported.
    }
    int width = ANativeWindow_getWidth(window); // 获取窗口宽度
    int height = ANativeWindow_getHeight(window); // 获取窗口高度
    GLint sampleCount; // 多重采样数
    glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0); // 绑定默认帧缓冲区
    glGetIntegerv(GL_SAMPLES, &amp;sampleCount); // 查询当前的多重采样数
    // 创建一个基于 GLES 的帧缓冲区渲染目标，用于离屏渲染
    m_renderTarget = rive::make_rcp&lt;rive::gpu::FramebufferRenderTargetGL&gt;(width, height, 0, sampleCount);
    // 初始化 Rive 的 PLS 渲染器
    m_plsRenderer = std::make_unique&lt;rive::RiveRenderer&gt;(renderContext);
    *success = true;
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    PLSThreadState::makeCurrent 函数的实现如下，eglMakeCurrent 是 EGL 环境创建的最后一步，作用是绑定 EGLSurface 和 EGLContext 到显示设备（EGLDisplay）。</p>
<p>​    helpers/thread_state_pls.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void PLSThreadState::makeCurrent(EGLSurface eglSurface)
{
    if (eglSurface == m_currentSurface)
    {
        return;
    }
	...
    // 绑定 EGLSurface 和 EGLContext 到显示设备 (EGLDisplay)
    eglMakeCurrent(m_display, eglSurface, eglSurface, m_context);
    m_currentSurface = eglSurface;
	...
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="464-创建-canvasworkerimpl">4.6.4 创建 CanvasWorkerImpl</h3>
<p>​    CanvasWorkerImpl 的构造函数如下。这里主要创建了 CanvasRenderer 对象，保存在 m_canvasRenderer 中，CanvasRenderer 继承 rive::Renderer，其源码不在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-android" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-android</a> 代码库中，在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-runtime</a> 代码库中，详见 → <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/blob/main/include/rive/renderer.hpp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">renderer.hpp</a>、<a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/blob/main/src/renderer.cpp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">renderer.cpp</a>；接着通过 NewGlobalRef(ktSurface) 将传入的局部引用 ktSurface 转换为全局引用，并存储在 m_ktSurface 中（全局引用会阻止 Java 垃圾回收器回收该对象，直到显式释放）。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">class CanvasWorkerImpl : public WorkerImpl
{
public:
    CanvasWorkerImpl(jobject ktSurface, bool* success) :
        m_canvasRenderer{std::make_unique&lt;CanvasRenderer&gt;()}
    {
        m_ktSurface = GetJNIEnv()-&gt;NewGlobalRef(ktSurface);
        *success = true;
    }

private:
    std::unique_ptr&lt;CanvasRenderer&gt; m_canvasRenderer;
    jobject m_ktSurface = nullptr;
};
</code></pre>
<h1 id="5-渲染流程">5 渲染流程</h1>
<p>​    渲染流程图如下。</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3135663/202510/3135663-20251002122604913-1433727381.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="51-rendererdoframe">5.1 Renderer.doFrame</h2>
<p>​    Renderer 实现了 Choreographer.FrameCallback 接口，重写了其 doFrame 方法，其 doFrame 和 scheduleFrame 方法源码如下。</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.renderers.Renderer.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">@CallSuper
override fun doFrame(frameTimeNanos: Long) {
	if (isPlaying) {
		cppDoFrame(cppPointer)
		scheduleFrame()
	}
}

open fun scheduleFrame() {
	Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post {
		Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(this@Renderer)
	}
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="52-jni-cppdoframe">5.2 JNI cppDoFrame</h2>
<p>​    全局搜索 "Renderer_cppDoFrame"，找到 JNI 中的 cppDoFrame 函数的实现如下。</p>
<p>​    bindings/bindings_renderer.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
Java_app_rive_runtime_kotlin_renderers_Renderer_cppDoFrame(JNIEnv*, jobject, jlong rendererRef)
{
	reinterpret_cast&lt;JNIRenderer*&gt;(rendererRef)-&gt;doFrame();
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="53-jnirendererdoframe">5.3 JNIRenderer::doFrame</h2>
<p>​    JNIRenderer::doFrame 的源码如下。m_worker 是 RefWorker 类的实例，RefWorker 继承 WorkThread，WorkThread 中创建了工作线程（见 3.5 节)，并且有个 run 函数，m_worker-&gt;run 表示把任务提交到 WorkThread 中的工作线程中执行。m_workerImpl 是 4.6 节创建的 WorkerImpl 对象（可能是 PLSWorkerImpl 或 CanavsWorkerImpl）。</p>
<p>​    models/jni_renderer.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void JNIRenderer::doFrame()
{
    if (m_numScheduledFrames &gt;= kMaxScheduledFrames)
    {
        return;
    }

    m_worker-&gt;run([this](DrawableThreadState* threadState) {
        if (!m_workerImpl)
            return;
        auto now = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        m_workerImpl-&gt;doFrame(m_tracer, threadState, m_ktRenderer, now);
        m_numScheduledFrames--;
        calculateFps(now);
    });
    m_numScheduledFrames++;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="54-workerimpldoframe">5.4 WorkerImpl::doFrame</h2>
<h3 id="541-doframe">5.4.1 doFrame</h3>
<p>​    WorkerImpl::doFrame 的源码如下。tracer 是性能追踪器，用于测量各阶段耗时，它在 JNIRenderer 中创建（见 3.3 节），这里有 3 个追踪标签，分别是 "<strong>draw()</strong>"、"<strong>flush()</strong>"、"<strong>swapBuffers()</strong>"。m_ktAdvanceCallback 在 start 函数中定义，指向 kotlin 中 Renderer.advance 函数；m_ktDrawCallback 在 start 函数中定义，指向 kotlin 中 Renderer.draw 函数。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void WorkerImpl::doFrame(ITracer* tracer, DrawableThreadState* threadState, jobject ktRenderer,
    std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::time_point frameTime)
{
    if (!m_isStarted)
    {
        return;
    }

    float fElapsedMs = std::chrono::duration&lt;float&gt;(frameTime - m_lastFrameTime).count();
    m_lastFrameTime = frameTime;

    auto env = GetJNIEnv();

    // m_ktAdvanceCallback 在 start 函数中定义, 指向 kotlin 中 Renderer.advance 函数
    JNIExceptionHandler::CallVoidMethod(env, ktRenderer, m_ktAdvanceCallback, fElapsedMs);

    tracer-&gt;beginSection("draw()");

    // 准备渲染状态, 调用 eglMakeCurrent 函数, 或 surface.lockCanvas 函数
    prepareForDraw(threadState);
    // m_ktDrawCallback 在 start 函数中定义, 指向 kotlin 中 Renderer.draw 函数
    JNIExceptionHandler::CallVoidMethod(env, ktRenderer, m_ktDrawCallback);

    tracer-&gt;beginSection("flush()");
    flush(threadState); // 提交渲染指令
    tracer-&gt;endSection(); // flush

    tracer-&gt;beginSection("swapBuffers()");
    threadState-&gt;swapBuffers(); // 交换缓冲区
    tracer-&gt;endSection(); // swapBuffers

    tracer-&gt;endSection(); // draw()
}
</code></pre>
<p>​     接下来，分别介绍 prepareForDraw、flush、swapBuffers。</p>
<h3 id="542-preparefordraw">5.4.2 prepareForDraw</h3>
<p>​    <strong>1）EGLWorkerImpl::prepareForDraw</strong></p>
<p>​    EGLWorkerImpl 的 prepareForDraw 函数源码如下。PLSThreadState 中实现了 makeCurrent 函数（见 2.6.3 节），eglThreadState-&gt;makeCurrent 中 调用了 eglMakeCurrent 函数，eglMakeCurrent 是 EGL 环境创建的最后一步，作用是绑定 EGLSurface 和 EGLContext 到显示设备（EGLDisplay）。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">virtual void prepareForDraw(DrawableThreadState* threadState) const override
{
	auto eglThreadState = static_cast&lt;EGLThreadState*&gt;(threadState);
	// 里面调用了 eglMakeCurrent, 用于绑定 EGLSurface 和 EGLContext 到显示设备 (EGLDisplay)
	eglThreadState-&gt;makeCurrent(m_eglSurface);
	clear(threadState);
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    <strong>2）CanvasWorkerImpl::prepareForDraw</strong></p>
<p>​    CanvasWorkerImpl 的 prepareForDraw 函数源码如下。其作用是通过 surface.lockCanvas 方法拿到 Canvas 对象。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void CanvasWorkerImpl::prepareForDraw(DrawableThreadState*) const
{
    m_canvasRenderer-&gt;bindCanvas(m_ktSurface);
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    bindCanvas 函数源码如下，m_ktCanvas 是通过 surface.lockCanvas 函数获取的 Canvas 对象。</p>
<p>​    models/canvas_renderer.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void bindCanvas(jobject ktSurface)
{
	...
	JNIEnv* env = GetJNIEnv();
    // 通过 surface.lockCanvas 函数获取 Canvas 对象
	m_ktCanvas = env-&gt;NewGlobalRef(GetCanvas(ktSurface));
    // 通过 canvas.getWidth 函数获取 Canvas 的宽度
	m_width = JNIExceptionHandler::CallIntMethod(env, m_ktCanvas, GetCanvasWidthMethodId());
    // 通过 canvas.getHeight 函数获取 Canvas 的高度
	m_height = JNIExceptionHandler::CallIntMethod(env, m_ktCanvas, GetCanvasHeightMethodId());
	Clear(m_ktCanvas);
}

static jobject GetCanvas(jobject ktSurface)
{
	return GetJNIEnv()-&gt;CallObjectMethod(ktSurface, GetSurfaceLockCanvasMethodId(), nullptr);
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    GetSurfaceLockCanvasMethodId 用于获取 surface.lockCanvas 的方法 id，具体实现如下。这里没有调用 surface.lockHardwareCanvas 方法，说明 Canvas 渲染方式是软渲染（即 CPU 渲染，而不是 GPU 渲染）。</p>
<p>​    models/jni_refs.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">jmethodID GetSurfaceLockCanvasMethodId()
{
    return GetMethodId(GetAndroidSurfaceClass(), "lockCanvas", "(Landroid/graphics/Rect;)Landroid/graphics/Canvas;");
}

jmethodID GetMethodId(jclass clazz, const char* name, const char* sig)
{
    JNIEnv* env = GetJNIEnv();
    jmethodID output = env-&gt;GetMethodID(clazz, name, sig);
    env-&gt;DeleteLocalRef(clazz);
    return output;
}

jclass GetAndroidSurfaceClass() { return GetClass("android/view/Surface"); }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="543-flush">5.4.3 flush</h3>
<p>​    <strong>1）PLSWorkerImpl::flush</strong></p>
<p>​    PLSWorkerImpl 的 flush 函数如下。renderContext-&gt;flush 函数的源码不在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-android" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-android</a> 代码库中，在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-runtime</a> 代码库中，详见 → <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/blob/main/renderer/src/render_context.cpp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">render_context.cpp</a>。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void PLSWorkerImpl::flush(DrawableThreadState* threadState) const
{
    PLSThreadState* plsThreadState = PLSWorkerImpl::PlsThreadState(threadState);
    rive::gpu::RenderContext* renderContext = plsThreadState-&gt;renderContext();
    renderContext-&gt;flush({.renderTarget = m_renderTarget.get()});
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    <strong>2）CanvasWorkerImpl::flush</strong></p>
<p>​    CanvasWorkerImpl 的 flush 函数如下，最终会调用 surface.unlockCanvasAndPost 函数。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void CanvasWorkerImpl::flush(DrawableThreadState*) const
{
    m_canvasRenderer-&gt;unlockAndPost(m_ktSurface);
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    models/canvas_renderer.hpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void unlockAndPost(jobject ktSurface)
{
	JNIEnv* env = GetJNIEnv();
	JNIExceptionHandler::CallVoidMethod(env, ktSurface, GetSurfaceUnlockCanvasAndPostMethodId(), m_ktCanvas);
	m_width = -1;
	m_height = -1;
	env-&gt;DeleteGlobalRef(m_ktCanvas);
	m_ktCanvas = nullptr;
}
</code></pre>
<p>​    GetSurfaceUnlockCanvasAndPostMethodId 函数调用了 surface.unlockCanvasAndPost 函数，具体实现如下。</p>
<p>​    models/jni_refs.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">jmethodID GetSurfaceUnlockCanvasAndPostMethodId()
{
    return GetMethodId(GetAndroidSurfaceClass(), "unlockCanvasAndPost", "(Landroid/graphics/Canvas;)V");
}

jmethodID GetMethodId(jclass clazz, const char* name, const char* sig)
{
    JNIEnv* env = GetJNIEnv();
    jmethodID output = env-&gt;GetMethodID(clazz, name, sig);
    env-&gt;DeleteLocalRef(clazz);
    return output;
}

jclass GetAndroidSurfaceClass() { return GetClass("android/view/Surface"); }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="544-eglthreadstateswapbuffers">5.4.4 EGLThreadState::swapBuffers</h3>
<p>​    DrawableThreadState 的子类中，只有 EGLThreadState 重写了 swapBuffers 函数，如下。eglSwapBuffers 函数用于交换缓冲区。</p>
<p>​    helpers/thread_state_egl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void EGLThreadState::swapBuffers()
{
    eglSwapBuffers(m_display, m_currentSurface); // 交换缓冲区
    EGL_ERR_CHECK();
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="55-riveartboardrendererdraw">5.5 RiveArtboardRenderer.draw</h2>
<p>​    5.4.1 节 WorkerImpl::doFrame 函数中，在 prepareForDraw 之后，调用了 m_ktDrawCallback，它指向的是 kotlin 中 Renderer.draw 函数，它是个抽象函数，RiveArtboardRenderer 中实现了该函数，如下。controller 是 RiveFileController 对象，它在 RiveAnimationView 的 init 代码块中创建，在 createRenderer 函数中传递给 RiveArtboardRenderer。activeArtboard 是 Artboard 对象，</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.renderers.RiveArtboardRenderer.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">@WorkerThread
override fun draw() {
	synchronized(controller.file?.lock ?: this) {
		...
		controller.activeArtboard?.draw(cppPointer, fit, alignment, scaleFactor = scaleFactor)
	}
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="56-artboarddraw">5.6 Artboard.draw</h2>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.core.Artboard.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">@WorkerThread
fun draw(rendererAddress: Long, fit: Fit, alignment: Alignment, scaleFactor: Float = 1.0f) {
	synchronized(lock) {
		cppDrawAligned(cppPointer, rendererAddress, fit, alignment, scaleFactor)
	}
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="57-jni-cppdrawaligned">5.7 JNI cppDrawAligned</h2>
<p>​    全局搜索 "Artboard_cppDrawAligned"，找到 JNI 中的 cppDrawAligned 函数的实现如下。首先获取 rive::ArtboardInstance 对象，接着通过 getRendererOnWorkerThread 函数获取 rive::RiveRenderer 或 CanavsRenderer 对象，最后调用 artboard-&gt;draw(renderer) 函数渲染一帧画面。rive::ArtboardInstance 的源码不在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-android" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-android</a> 代码库中，在 <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">rive-runtime</a> 代码库中，详见 → <a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/blob/main/include/rive/artboard.hpp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">artboard.hpp</a>、<a href="https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime/blob/main/src/artboard.cpp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">artboard.cpp</a>。</p>
<p>​    bindings/bindings_artboard.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
Java_app_rive_runtime_kotlin_core_Artboard_cppDrawAligned(JNIEnv* env, jobject, jlong artboardRef,
	jlong rendererRef, jobject ktFit, jobject ktAlignment, jfloat scaleFactor)
{
	auto artboard = reinterpret_cast&lt;rive::ArtboardInstance*&gt;(artboardRef); // 获取 ArtboardInstance 对象(未开放源码)
	auto jniWrapper = reinterpret_cast&lt;JNIRenderer*&gt;(rendererRef); // 获取 JNIRenderer 对象
    // 获取 rive::RiveRenderer 对象或 CanvasRenderer 对象
	rive::Renderer* renderer = jniWrapper-&gt;getRendererOnWorkerThread();

	rive::Fit fit = GetFit(env, ktFit);
	rive::Alignment alignment = GetAlignment(env, ktAlignment);

	renderer-&gt;save(); // 如果 renderer 是 CanvasRenderer, 将调用 canvas.save 函数
	renderer-&gt;align(fit, alignment,
		rive::AABB(0, 0, jniWrapper-&gt;width(), jniWrapper-&gt;height()),
		artboard-&gt;bounds(),scaleFactor);
	artboard-&gt;draw(renderer);
	renderer-&gt;restore(); // 如果 renderer 是 CanvasRenderer, 将调用 canvas.restore 函数
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="6-启动渲染流程">6 启动渲染流程</h1>
<p>​    启动渲染流程图如下。</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3135663/202510/3135663-20251002122604935-1395616106.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="61-启动渲染的源头">6.1 启动渲染的源头</h2>
<p>​    在 Rive 的 kotlin 源码中，通过调用 Renderer.start 函数启动渲染，但是，用户无法直接调用该函数，调用该函数的地方非常多，分成以下几类。</p>
<p>​    <strong>1）直接调用</strong></p>
<p>​    以下函数中会直接调用 Renderer.start 函数启动渲染。</p>
<ul>
<li>RiveAnimationView.onAttachedToWindow</li>
<li>RiveTextureView.onVisibilityChanged</li>
<li>Renderer.setSurface</li>
</ul>
<p>​    <strong>2）RiveFileController.onStart</strong></p>
<p>​    RiveFileController.onStart 也指向了 Renderer.start 函数，在 RiveFileController 的 fit、alignment、layoutScaleFactor、layoutScaleFactorAutomatic 等属性变化、以及 autoplay 属性变为 true 时，会调用 onStart.invoke 启动渲染。</p>
<p>​    <strong>3）间接调用</strong></p>
<p>​    在 RiveAnimationView 的以下函数中，经过多步调用，最终会调用到 Renderer.start 函数启动渲染。</p>
<ul>
<li>play</li>
<li>reset</li>
<li>fireState</li>
<li>setBooleanState</li>
<li>setNumberState</li>
<li>setTextRunValue</li>
<li>onTouchEvent</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="62-rendererstart">6.2 Renderer.start</h2>
<p>​    Renderer 的 start 函数如下，通过 Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback 函数让 doFrame 函数每帧调用一次，通过 cppStart 函数启动 Rive 引擎（rive::AudioEngine::RuntimeEngine）。</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.renderers.Renderer.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">abstract class Renderer(
    @get:VisibleForTesting(otherwise = VisibleForTesting.PRIVATE)
    var type: RendererType = Rive.defaultRendererType,
    val trace: Boolean = false
) : NativeObject(NULL_POINTER), Choreographer.FrameCallback

    fun start() {
        if (isPlaying) return
        if (!isAttached) return
        if (!hasCppObject) return
        isPlaying = true
        cppStart(cppPointer)
        scheduleFrame()
    }

	open fun scheduleFrame() {
        Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(this@Renderer)
        }
    }

	@CallSuper
    override fun doFrame(frameTimeNanos: Long) {
        if (isPlaying) {
            cppDoFrame(cppPointer)
            scheduleFrame()
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="63-jni-cppstart">6.3 JNI cppStart</h2>
<p>​    全局搜索 "Renderer_cppStart"，找到 JNI 中的 cppStart 函数的实现如下。</p>
<p>​    bindings/bindings_renderers.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
Java_app_rive_runtime_kotlin_renderers_Renderer_cppStart(JNIEnv*, jobject, jlong rendererRef)
{
	reinterpret_cast&lt;JNIRenderer*&gt;(rendererRef)-&gt;start();
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="64-jnirendererstart">6.4 JNIRenderer::start</h2>
<p>​    JNIRenderer::start 的源码如下。m_worker 是 RefWorker 类的实例，RefWorker 继承 WorkThread，WorkThread 中创建了工作线程（见 3.5 节)，并且有个 run 函数，m_worker-&gt;run 表示把任务提交到 WorkThread 中的工作线程中执行。m_workerImpl 是 4.6 节创建的 WorkerImpl 对象（可能是 PLSWorkerImpl 或 CanavsWorkerImpl）。</p>
<p>​    models/jni_renderer.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void JNIRenderer::start()
{
    m_worker-&gt;run([this](DrawableThreadState* threadState) {
        if (!m_workerImpl)
            return;
        auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        m_fpsLastFrameTime = now;
        m_workerImpl-&gt;start(m_ktRenderer, now);
    });
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="65-workerimplstart">6.5 WorkerImpl::start</h2>
<p>​    WorkerImpl::start 函数源码如下。这里主要初始化 m_ktRendererClass 、m_ktDrawCallback、m_ktAdvanceCallback，并启动 Rive 引擎。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void WorkerImpl::start(jobject ktRenderer, std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::time_point frameTime)
{
    auto env = GetJNIEnv();
    jclass ktClass = env-&gt;GetObjectClass(ktRenderer);
    m_ktRendererClass = reinterpret_cast&lt;jclass&gt;(env-&gt;NewWeakGlobalRef(ktClass)); // 获取 kotlin 中 Renderer 对象
    m_ktDrawCallback = env-&gt;GetMethodID(m_ktRendererClass, "draw", "()V"); // 指向 Renderer.draw 方法
    m_ktAdvanceCallback = env-&gt;GetMethodID(m_ktRendererClass, "advance", "(F)V");  // 指向 Renderer.advance 方法
    m_lastFrameTime = frameTime;
    m_isStarted = true;
    if (auto engine = rive::AudioEngine::RuntimeEngine(false))
    {
        engine-&gt;start(); // 启动 Rive 引擎
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="7-暂停渲染流程">7 暂停渲染流程</h1>
<p>​    暂停渲染流程图如下。</p>
<p><img alt="img" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3135663/202510/3135663-20251002122604937-989787852.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="71-暂停渲染的源头">7.1 暂停渲染的源头</h2>
<p>​    在 Rive 的 kotlin 源码中，通过调用 Renderer.stop 函数暂停渲染，但是，用户无法直接调用该函数，调用该函数的地方非常多，主要有以下几处。</p>
<ul>
<li>RiveAnimationView.pause</li>
<li>RiveAnimationView.onDetachedFromWindow</li>
<li>RiveTextureView.onVisibilityChanged</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="72-rendererstop">7.2 Renderer.stop</h2>
<p>​    Renderer 的 stop 函数如下，通过 cppStop 函数暂停 Rive 引擎（rive::AudioEngine::RuntimeEngine），通过 Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback 函数移除 doFrame 回调。</p>
<p>​    app.rive.runtime.kotlin.renderers.Renderer.kt</p>
<pre><code class="language-Kotlin">abstract class Renderer(
    @get:VisibleForTesting(otherwise = VisibleForTesting.PRIVATE)
    var type: RendererType = Rive.defaultRendererType,
    val trace: Boolean = false
) : NativeObject(NULL_POINTER), Choreographer.FrameCallback

    @CallSuper
    fun stop() {
        stopThread()
        Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post { // postFrameCallback must be called from the main looper
            Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(this@Renderer)
        }
    }

    @CallSuper
    internal fun stopThread() {
        if (!isPlaying) return
        if (!hasCppObject) return
        isPlaying = false
        cppStop(cppPointer)
    }

	open fun scheduleFrame() {
        Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post {
            Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(this@Renderer)
        }
    }

	@CallSuper
    override fun doFrame(frameTimeNanos: Long) {
        if (isPlaying) {
            cppDoFrame(cppPointer)
            scheduleFrame()
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="73-jni-cppstop">7.3 JNI cppStop</h2>
<p>​    全局搜索 "Renderer_cppStop"，找到 JNI 中的 cppStop 函数的实现如下。</p>
<p>​    bindings/bindings_renderers.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
Java_app_rive_runtime_kotlin_renderers_Renderer_cppStop(JNIEnv*, jobject, jlong rendererRef)
{
	reinterpret_cast&lt;JNIRenderer*&gt;(rendererRef)-&gt;stop();
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="74-jnirendererstop">7.4 JNIRenderer::stop</h2>
<p>​    JNIRenderer::stop 的源码如下。m_worker 是 RefWorker 类的实例，RefWorker 继承 WorkThread，WorkThread 中创建了工作线程（见 3.5 节)，并且有个 run 函数，m_worker-&gt;run 表示把任务提交到 WorkThread 中的工作线程中执行。m_workerImpl 是 4.6 节创建的 WorkerImpl 对象（可能是 PLSWorkerImpl 或 CanavsWorkerImpl）。</p>
<p>​    models/jni_renderer.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void JNIRenderer::stop()
{
    m_worker-&gt;run([this](DrawableThreadState* threadState) {
        if (!m_workerImpl)
            return;
        m_workerImpl-&gt;stop();
    });
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="75-workerimplstop">7.5 WorkerImpl::stop</h2>
<p>​    WorkerImpl::stop 函数源码如下。这里主要暂停 Rive 引擎，并将 m_ktRendererClass 、m_ktDrawCallback、m_ktAdvanceCallback 设置为空。</p>
<p>​    models/worker_impl.cpp</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">void WorkerImpl::stop()
{
    if (auto engine = rive::AudioEngine::RuntimeEngine(false))
    {
        engine-&gt;stop(); // 暂停 Rive 引擎
    }
    auto env = GetJNIEnv();
    if (m_ktRendererClass != nullptr)
    {
        env-&gt;DeleteWeakGlobalRef(m_ktRendererClass);
    }
    m_ktRendererClass = nullptr;
    m_ktDrawCallback = nullptr;
    m_ktAdvanceCallback = nullptr;
    m_isStarted = false;
}
</code></pre>
